summary: Frontend-only portfolio for Sarthak Sahu fully tested via Playwright. All 37 functional checks passed: page loads cleanly with zero console errors, navbar with 5 data-testid links works (desktop + mobile), hero CTAs resolve to correct anchors and scroll smoothly, About stats (0-3), Experience cards (0-1), Project cards (0-1) with correct external links (mediatek.com, github.com/sarthak5461/ngo-app), Contact mailto/whatsapp/resume buttons with correct hrefs, social LinkedIn/GitHub links exact match, resume.pdf returns HTTP 200 (189KB). Mobile menu toggle at 375px viewport opens and exposes all 5 mobile nav links. Hero CTA scroll behavior verified on #contact and #projects.
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: Experience entry duration 'May 2023 — Feb 2026' includes a future end date relative to current month (Jan 2026) - verify intent (could be year typo for 2024/Present).
Minor: Hero section has id='hero' but nav-logo links to '#hero'; consider adding to navLinks set or leaving as-is (works correctly currently).

Cosmetic: contact-mailto and contact-whatsapp hrefs include query params (subject, text). data-testid assertion uses startsWith / contains which is correct, but worth keeping in mind for any strict-equality tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Portfolio is static React (no backend). All sections have data-testid attributes per spec. Resume PDF served from /resume.pdf via frontend public dir. No console errors, smooth scroll works via CSS. If retesting, focus on visual regression / new content additions only.
